reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that stabilizes prompt-cache prefixes by relocating working-directory context and canonicalizing tool-schema keys, while reporting provider cache metrics through /cache.

summaries.zh: 通过稳定提示词缓存前缀、规范化工具架构键顺序并提供 /cache 指令，帮助 DeepSeek Harness 查看缓存指标。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that stabilizes prompt-cache prefixes, canonicalizes tool-schema keys, and reports provider cache metrics through /cache.

capabilities: Relocates the working-directory value into the runtime-context snapshot to improve prompt-prefix reuse.
Canonicalizes object-key order within tool schemas.
Provides a human-only /cache command reporting provider cache token metrics.
